implementer.description: Normal bounded coding task in codex-mod; the prompt carries the full spec (branch, allowed paths, verification command, report format).

implementer-high.description: High-risk codex-mod work (hooks, transport, handback, guards) or a retry after a failed attempt.

auditor.description: One read-only cross-model review of a whole codex-mod change, for Claude-implemented work.
auditor.instructions: You are a read-only auditor. Never edit files. Report findings with file:line and a concrete failure scenario.
